close_reason: Added SetErrorType::Custom(String) + SetErrorType::custom() constructor. mdn.rs uses custom("mdnAlreadySent"). Manual serde: serialize as bare string, deserialize unknown → Custom.
description: SetErrorType::MdnAlreadySent is defined in jmap-server/src/backend.rs, the base server crate that is supposed to be unaware of JMAP extensions. Every future extension (calendar, contacts, tasks) that needs a domain-specific error type would also need to add a variant to this enum in the base crate. This creates a design that scales poorly — the base crate grows with each extension rather than being stable. The consequence: adding jmap-calendar-server requires a version bump to jmap-server to add CalendarAlreadyProcessed. The right fix is either (a) a Custom(String) variant in SetErrorType for extension-defined errors, or (b) moving SetErrorType to an open-coded string approach for extension errors. This decision needs to be made before jmap-server 1.0 or the API is locked in.
notes: Deferred: requires architectural decision — either add Custom(String) variant to SetErrorType, or accept that extension errors live in jmap-server. The existing RFC 8621 errors (MailboxHasChild etc.) already established this pattern. Needs human input.
title: MdnAlreadySent bleeds extension concern into jmap-server base crate
